joseph-manacmul.text: Per the Downey Patriot, his campaign announced endorsements from the Downey Education Association and CSEA Units 1 and 2.

source.title: The Downey Patriot: Local leaders back Manacmul for DUSD board (2026-09-24)

joseph-manacmul.text: Says Downey schools 'should be judged by whether they work for the kids and families who depend on them, not by politics, not by ideology'; backs fiscal responsibility, 'real partnership with teachers and staff,' and keeping a stable board.

source.title: Joe Manacmul for Downey School Board, Trustee Area 7: About

joseph-manacmul.text: Says he served on the campaign committees for school bond Measures O and K and for city Measure S (public safety, parks and infrastructure funding).

source.title: Joe Manacmul for Downey School Board, Trustee Area 7: About

joseph-manacmul.text: As appointed trustee, says he has 'studied budgets closely, walked Measure K construction sites, and pushed for clearer answers on spending, because parents deserve facts, not guesswork.'

source.title: Joe Manacmul for Downey School Board, Trustee Area 7: home page
